verses.text: "Tell the people of Israel: When a woman becomes pregnant and gives birth to a boy, she will be unclean for seven days, just as she is unclean during her monthly period.
On the eighth day the boy must be circumcised.
Then she must wait thirty-three days to be made clean from her bleeding. She must not touch anything holy or go into the holy place until her days of cleansing are over.
If she gives birth to a girl, she will be unclean for two weeks, as during her period. Then she must wait sixty-six days to be made clean from her bleeding.

When her days of cleansing are over, for a son or a daughter, she must bring the priest at the door of the Tent of Meeting a one-year-old lamb for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon or a dove for a sin offering.
The priest will offer them to the LORD and make her right with God, and she will be clean from her bleeding. This is the teaching for a woman who gives birth to a boy or a girl.
If she cannot afford a lamb, she may bring two doves or two young pigeons, one for a burnt offering and the other for a sin offering. The priest will make her right with God, and she will be clean."
